copyDescription: Copy the game, mods, and settings into a separate folder.
copyNameInvalid: Enter a copy name between 1 and 80 characters.
copySavesHelp: Copy the current worlds with this game.
exportDescription: Export a .mrpack with mods and settings. The game itself, cached assets, and player accounts are excluded.
exportSavesHelp: Include your worlds in the modpack.
keepHelp: Game files and saves stay in their current folder.
deleteHelp: Delete the entire game folder, including mods, settings, and saves.
deleteWarning: The folder below and all its files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
lockedWarning: Close the game and wait for the current task to finish first.
